observations: Photo 0 shows a Yamaha electronic keyboard with a built-in speaker grille on the right side.
The control panel display area is visible but the screen content is not readable.
A model label on the front panel appears to read 'PSR-550' (partially visible).
No clear photo of the full keyboard brand/model name plate, ports, or power/adapter.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a powered-on screen, audio output, or any test/recording.
Photo 0 appears to show 'PSR-550' on the front label, not PSR-650.

risks.risk: Model mismatch: seller says PSR650 but the photo appears to show PSR-550; wrong model affects price and features.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the model nameplate/label showing the exact model (PSR-550 vs PSR-650) and the full front panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case matching what’s visible in the photo (PSR-550), and treat any mismatch as a reason to not pay a PSR-650 price.

risks.risk: Not actually working (keys/speakers/sound, display, and buttons may be faulty).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video: power on, show the display, play a few notes, and demonstrate volume/speaker output (or headphone output).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst case: needs repair / limited functionality).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand) or damaged ports/cables.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of: included items list, the power adapter (or charging/power input), sustain pedal (if any), and close-ups of all ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming accessories may be missing and/or ports may need checking.

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage not fully visible (scratches, broken speaker grille, loose panel).
risks.proof: Ask for additional photos from multiple angles: speaker grille close-up, both sides, and the underside/hinges/stands (if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end of the comparable range for used keyboards.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the exact model label/nameplate (must show PSR-550 or PSR-650 clearly).
Short video test: power on + display visible + play keys + show volume working (and speaker sound).
Photo of the power adapter/charger (or proof of how it powers) and close-up of power/ports.
Photos of included accessories (sustain pedal/stand) and underside/any damage.
response.reason: The photo suggests PSR-550 while the seller text says PSR650, and the 'working perfectly' claim is not verifiable from a single non-powered photo. Proof is needed to confirm the exact model and functionality before pricing confidently.
